scripts.start: pnpm build:wasm && sh -c 'trap "kill 0" INT TERM EXIT; pnpm server & pnpm --filter web dev & wait'
scripts.build:wasm: cd wasm && GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' -o ../web/public/sim.wasm . && cp "$(go env GOROOT)/lib/wasm/wasm_exec.js" ../web/public/
scripts.test: pnpm test:go && pnpm test:wasm && pnpm --filter web typecheck
scripts.test:wasm: for m in sim wasm; do (cd $m && GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go test -exec="$(go env GOROOT)/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec" ./...) || exit 1; done
scripts.balance: go run ./tools/balance > docs/balance-report.md && echo wrote docs/balance-report.md
